description: Entirely fictional engineering evidence, for memory mechanism evaluation only.
question: Assess whether the fictional Delta cooling valve is ready for a controlled bench trial. Distinguish observations from inference, cite source identifiers, and revise your assessment when evidence changes.

sources.title: Initial intake log
sources.text: Fictional technician Iris recorded three successful valve closures at the indicated 40 kPa. The gauge calibration was not checked.

sources.title: Independent bench log
sources.text: Fictional technician Rowan observed one delayed closure in three tests at an indicated 40 kPa. The controller firmware version was not recorded.

sources.title: Later calibration correction
sources.text: A later fictional calibration check found that the intake-log gauge read 10 kPa high. Those tests therefore occurred at approximately 30 kPa, not 40 kPa. This does not establish performance at 40 kPa.

sources.title: Later firmware note
sources.text: The fictional bench-log controller used firmware R2; the intended trial uses R3. No evidence here establishes that R3 fixes delayed closure.

sources.title: Withheld negative control
sources.text: This fictional sealed record must never be exposed to an agent.
